avoid_supplements.name: Iron supplements (high dose)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Entacapone chelates iron, reducing iron absorption and entacapone efficacy; iron-rich supplements may decrease COMT inhibitor levels
avoid_supplements.action: Separate dosing by at least 2-3 hours; monitor for reduced Parkinson's symptom control

avoid_supplements.name: Sympathomimetic amines (ephedrine, pseudoephedrine supplements)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Entacapone increases levodopa bioavailability and dopamine levels; sympathomimetics combined with increased catecholamines risk hypertensive crisis
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid all decongestant supplements; counsel patient to avoid OTC cold/allergy products

caution_supplements.name: Vitamin B6 (pyridoxine)
caution_supplements.mechanism: High-dose B6 may reduce levodopa efficacy by peripheral conversion, though entacapone's COMT inhibition partially mitigates this effect
caution_supplements.action: Keep B6 supplementation modest (<25 mg daily); monitor for symptom control changes

caution_supplements.name: Magnesium supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: May reduce entacapone and levodopa absorption via chelation if taken simultaneously
caution_supplements.action: Separate dosing by 2 hours from entacapone/levodopa combination

avoid_foods.name: High protein meals (concurrent with dosing)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Large neutral amino acids compete with levodopa for intestinal and blood-brain barrier transport; reduces levodopa efficacy despite COMT inhibition
avoid_foods.action: Take entacapone/levodopa on empty stomach or 1 hour before/after protein-rich meals

caution_foods.name: Iron-rich foods (red meat, spinach, fortified cereals)
caution_foods.mechanism: Dietary iron may chelate entacapone and reduce absorption; effect less significant than supplements
caution_foods.action: Avoid excessive iron-rich foods at time of entacapone dosing; monitor clinical response

caution_foods.name: Foods containing tyramine (aged cheeses, cured meats, fermented foods)
caution_foods.mechanism: Entacapone increases dopamine; excessive tyramine with elevated catecholamines poses theoretical hypertensive risk, though risk is lower than with MAOIs
caution_foods.action: Counsel moderation; no strict avoidance required but avoid excessive consumption

monitoring_notes: Monitor for reduced levodopa efficacy if iron supplements or high-protein meals are consumed concurrently; assess blood pressure and heart rate regularly, especially if patient uses any sympathomimetic-containing products. Educate on timing of meals relative to medication dosing for optimal therapeutic effect.
